game.name: W.A.R H.A.M.S
game.theme: Sci-fi corporate military conquest on alien planets
game.tagline: Competing corporate armies fight for planetary dominance through resource control, tactical combat, and political conspiring

victory_conditions.name: Spaceport Domination
victory_conditions.description: Control majority of spaceports — HQ sends a full battalion, rivals can't resupply and flee off-world
victory_conditions.requirement: 2 players: fully control 5 of 6 spaceports. 3-4 players: fully control 4 of 6 spaceports. A spaceport is fully controlled when your flag is on it and no enemy soldiers occupy the hex (contested spaceports don't count).

victory_conditions.name: Military Supremacy
victory_conditions.description: Have 4 full squads of 7 soldiers — competition's HQs pull them back

victory_conditions.name: Dominance Victory
victory_conditions.description: Local population sides with you — you become sovereign
victory_conditions.requirement: Accumulate 50 Dominance Points from equipped BACs (add card DP each time you learn a new BAC or equip a new instance) and Battle Victory DP

victory_conditions.name: Final Round Resolution
victory_conditions.description: When any victory condition is met, the current round becomes the Final Round — all remaining players take their turn, then the winner is determined
victory_conditions.requirement: At end of Final Round: one player meets a condition = they win; multiple meet conditions = highest DP wins; no one meets a condition = highest DP wins; DP tied = play additional rounds

number_tokens.note: Numbers 1 & 2 are scarcer (2 tokens each), 3-6 have 3 tokens each. Placed on 15 resource-producing hexes only (one hex gets 2 tokens). Separatist Bases and Spaceports have printed numbers on the tile.

board.shape: Circular planet frame (5 interlocking cardboard puzzle pieces), 61 hexes fill the entire interior. Edge connection points (a, b, c, etc.) enable board wrapping — opposite edges are adjacent.

resources.name: Oil
resources.token: Oil Drum (black on white, black border)

resources.name: Electricity
resources.token: Lightning Bolt (yellow on white, yellow border)

resources.name: Intelligence
resources.token: Transmitting Wave (blue on white, blue border)

special_tiles.name: Separatist Base
special_tiles.mechanics: Each base has a printed number (2, 4, or 6). When the Separatist Die (grey d6) matches an unconquered base, spawn 3 Separatists there (if insufficient minis remain, spawn as many as possible — excess lost). When it matches a conquered base, that base's controller immediately gains 1 Local Favor, regardless of who rolled the die; this does not require all three bases to be conquered. Conquering requires defeating 7 Separatists — all Separatists (roaming and base defenders) apply −1 to defense dice only (minimum result 1); attack dice unmodified. Controller may Instigate Uprising (Phase 4): pay 3 Local Favor to spawn 3 Separatists at any unconquered base (once per round per conquered base).

special_tiles.name: Spaceport Drop Zone
special_tiles.mechanics: Each spaceport has a printed number (1–6). BACs land here on doubles matching the printed number. Can be captured for passive BAC collection.

bac_setup.description: Deal 3 BAC cards to each player. Each player picks 1, passes 2 left. Picks 1 from received cards, passes 1 left. Keeps the final card. Result: 3-card starting hand.

turn_phases.name: Resource Production
turn_phases.description: Roll 2d6 + 1 Separatist Die (grey). All 3 dice produce resources. At a matching unconquered base, the Separatist Die spawns 3 Separatists; at a matching conquered base, its controller immediately gains 1 Local Favor. Doubles = BAC from Planet Bound Area to matching spaceport. Triples = active player chooses spaceport placement + may move 1 Planet Bound BAC.

turn_phases.name: Activation Phase
turn_phases.description: Each Squad takes 2 actions (any type may be repeated): Move (move soldiers 1 hex, 2 with J.J, maintain coherency, claim hexes after), Combat (declare & resolve combat, claim hexes after), Logistics (unlock/equip BACs, acquire BACs, recruit soldiers, create Squads, trade with players or bank 3:1), Conspire (draw 3 keep 1), or Rest (roll 1d3, heal that many damage pegs within the Squad).

turn_phases.name: Salvage & Resource Gathering
turn_phases.description: The active player collects salvage, then 1 available token from each distinct resource-producing hex occupied by their Squads. Each hex provides resources once per turn. A BEAR-equipped soldier allows 1 additional token from that soldier's hex; multiple BEAR modules on one hex do not stack. Separatists block collection on their hex.

turn_phases.name: Separatists
turn_phases.description: The active player resolves all Separatists. Instigate Uprising first (conquered base owners may pay 3 Local Favor to spawn 3 Separatists at an unconquered base, once per base per round). Then every occupied hex loses 1 resource token. Each Separatist moves up to 3 hexes toward the resource-producing hex within 3 hexes that contains the most resource tokens; the active player breaks ties. If none qualifies, move toward the nearest resource-producing hex, even if empty. BAC cards and cargo containers are never targets. Move all Separatists before resolving combats; the player to the defender's left rolls Separatist dice.

actions.name: Move
actions.description: Move each soldier up to 1 hex (2 with J.J). Maintain squad coherency (within 2 hexes of a squadmate). Cannot move through Separatist-occupied hexes. Board wrapping applies. Claim hexes immediately after.

actions.name: Combat
actions.description: Declare an attack against an enemy Squad or Separatist group with at least one soldier in combat range. Resolve full combat sequence. Claim hexes immediately after.

actions.name: Logistics
actions.description: Unlock and equip BACs, re-equip unlocked types, acquire BAC cards from Spaceport, recruit soldiers, create new Squads, activate field modules, recharge tapped modules, trade resources with other players (two-sided only) or bank (3:1). All may be done in any order, any number of times, resources permitting.

actions.name: Conspire
actions.description: Draw 3 cards from the Conspire Deck, keep 1, discard 2 face-down. May be chosen twice to draw twice. Hand limit: 7 cards.

actions.name: Rest
actions.description: Roll 1d3 (1d6 halved, rounded up). Remove that many damage pegs from soldiers in the activating Squad. Player chooses distribution. Damage otherwise persists between turns.

combat_system.attack_defense_rolls: Each player rolls 1d6 per engaged soldier with an enemy in that soldier's combat range. Soldiers outside their range sit out. Attacker assigns dice to defender's soldiers. Defender aligns defense dice.
combat_system.more_soldiers_advantage: Extra dice are rolled but only best are chosen, giving advantage
combat_system.engagement_range: A soldier with no Hands-slot weapon has combat range 1: same hex or adjacent hex. It still rolls 1d6 normally. Equipping a Hands-slot weapon keeps range 1 unless that weapon states a longer range; other equipment slots do not increase empty-Hands range. Only soldiers with at least one enemy soldier in the target squad within their current range participate. S.L.I.M.E has range 3. B.A.S.R has range 2 and fires in pre-combat; L.P.M can extend eligible weapons to range 4.
combat_system.bonuses: Add equipment bonuses after initial roll
combat_system.card_play: Defender plays combat cards first, then attacker
combat_system.damage_resolution: Difference in dice = damage pegs inserted into divots on the defending soldier's base. Each base has 3 blood-drop divots; soldier takes 3 damage max, 4th = death.
combat_system.counterattack: Defending blocks with +2 or more difference trigger counterattack (defender becomes attacker). Counterattacks can chain - a counterattacker who wins by 2+ triggers another counterattack. Chains continue naturally until a roll fails to trigger another counter.
combat_system.defender_withdrawal: After all counterattacks and damage are resolved, the defender may withdraw any or all surviving engaged soldiers 1 hex away from the attacker for free. Follows normal movement rules (coherency, board wrapping, no moving through Separatists). Soldiers with no valid hex stay put. Only the defender withdraws; the attacker does not advance.
combat_system.battle_victory_dp: After withdrawal, compare total wounds inflicted by each side (damage pegs placed on enemy soldiers, including kills). The side that inflicted more wounds than they received earns Battle Victory DP equal to the difference, up to a maximum of 3 DP. If both sides inflicted equal wounds, neither earns DP. Both attacker and defender are eligible. Battle Victory DP is permanent and counts toward the Dominance victory.

module_activation.combat_modules: Activate during combat resolution at Step 3 (equipment bonuses). E.g., N.I.N.J.A.
module_activation.untapping: During a Logistics action, at required location (City/Spaceport), pay recharge cost.
module_activation.passive: Always active, no activation needed (H.C.A.R, S.A.P, etc.)

death.lethal_hit_roll: d6 determines which slot was hit (1=head, 2=backpack, 3=legs, 4-5=chest, 6=hands)
death.destroyed_module: Module in hit slot is destroyed (removed from game)
death.salvage: Owner picks 1 remaining module, attacker picks 1, rest left on hex as salvage (picked up for free by any soldier)
death.coherency_check: After death, check if surviving squadmates are beyond 2 hexes from all allies. Disconnected soldiers fight alone (own dice only, no Squad-level BAC effects) and must rejoin coherency during their next Move action.

squad_details.new_soldier_cost: 1 Local Favor + 1 Oil + 1 Industry + 1 Electricity (must be in/near city)

squad_coherency.rule: Every soldier must remain within 2 hexes of at least one other squadmate at all times
squad_coherency.exception: J.J (Jump Jets) may override coherency. Disconnected soldiers fight alone (own dice only) and cannot benefit from Squad-level BAC effects. May rejoin by moving back within 2 hexes.

basic_armament_cards.name: Standard Armor Plating Chest Piece
basic_armament_cards.text: This soldier gets +1 to its defense die.

basic_armament_cards.name: Standard Armor Plating Helmet
basic_armament_cards.text: This soldier gets +1 to its defense die.

basic_armament_cards.name: Jump Jets
basic_armament_cards.text: This soldier can move 2 hexes instead of 1. May override squad coherency — fights alone while disconnected (own dice only, no Squad-level BAC effects). Rejoin by moving within 2 hexes of a squadmate.

basic_armament_cards.name: Sensory Helmet, Advisory Drone
basic_armament_cards.text: If attacked, before combat starts, attacking player must reveal his conspire cards to you.

basic_armament_cards.name: Heavy Caliber Assault Rifle
basic_armament_cards.text: Range: 1 hex. Add +1 to this soldier's attack die.

basic_armament_cards.name: Personal Accuracy Enhancement Helmet
basic_armament_cards.text: This soldier gets +1 to its attack die while also equipped with H.C.A.R.

basic_armament_cards.name: Bolt Action Sniper Rifle
basic_armament_cards.text: Range: 2 hexes. Pre-combat: roll 2d6 (pick higher), target 1 soldier in range. Target defends normally (1d6). Sniper skips normal combat. While defending: both sniper and target get -1 to defense die.

basic_armament_cards.name: Squad Light Interoperable Mortar Encampment
basic_armament_cards.text: Choose 2 soldiers to carry S.L.I.M.E. Roll 4d6, assign as matchups following normal combat rules, target squad up to 3 hexes away. Target defends normally. Mortar crew skips normal combat. While defending: -1 to defense die. Civilian Damage Rule applies on City/Village hexes (all opposing players gain 2 Local Favor; attacker loses all Local Favor).

basic_armament_cards.name: Battlefield Extraction Airlift Rover
basic_armament_cards.text: During your Resource Gathering, this soldier's resource hex may provide 1 additional token. Multiple B.E.A.R modules on one hex do not stack.

basic_armament_cards.name: Personal Lasting Aid Surgical Treatment Enhancement Robot
basic_armament_cards.text: Remove up to 2 damage pegs from any soldier on the same hex. Tap this card. When in city or spaceport, pay 1 Electricity to recharge and untap.

basic_armament_cards.name: Nir Ion Nullifier Jammer Aid
basic_armament_cards.text: Add +3 to one defense die and tap this card. Spend 2 Electricity to recharge and untap.

basic_armament_cards.name: Deployable Unital Defense System
basic_armament_cards.bunker_dp: 2 DP permanent on deployment + 2 DP to hex controller
basic_armament_cards.text: Place a bunker token on this hex (1 per hex max). +1 to all defense dice for any unit on this hex (neutral fortification). Bunker persists until destroyed by attacker winning combat on it. One-use: remove the module after deployment, freeing the backpack slot.

basic_armament_cards.name: Laser Pointer Marker
basic_armament_cards.text: Other soldiers carrying B.A.S.R or S.L.I.M.E can target enemies in vicinity of L.P.M carrier. Max range 4 hexes.

basic_armament_cards.name: Repeating Shotgun
basic_armament_cards.text: Range: 1 hex. If target is on the same hex, add +2 to attack die. Otherwise add -1.

basic_armament_cards.name: Projectile Correcting Sub Machine Gun
basic_armament_cards.text: Range: 1 hex. If target is on the same hex, roll 3d6 for this soldier's attack instead of 1d6 and pick the highest result.

basic_armament_cards.name: Custom Armor Plating Chest

basic_armament_cards.name: Custom Armor Plating Helmet
basic_armament_cards.text: This soldier gets +2 to its defense die.

basic_armament_cards.name: Custom Armor Plating Legs

conspire_cards.name: Deal with Local Militia
conspire_cards.text: Choose a hex up to 2 hexes from your soldier. Spawn 3 local militia to attack a nearby enemy immediately (spawning is mandatory). Use spare Separatist minis or any substitute if unavailable. Militia have -1 to all dice and disperse after attack.

conspire_cards.name: Traveling Med Bay

conspire_cards.name: Build a Wind Farm

conspire_cards.name: Build a Follower Camp

conspire_cards.name: Hack a PortNet Relay
conspire_cards.text: Take 1 face-up BAC from the Planet Bound Area into your hand. Immediately refill the empty slot from the Spaceport Deck.

conspire_cards.name: Recruit Eager Volunteers
conspire_cards.text: Gain 1 Local Favor. Roll 1d6: on 5-6, gain 1 additional resource token of any type you choose.

conspire_cards.name: Scout Ahead
conspire_cards.text: Gain 1 Intelligence. Roll 1d6: on 5-6, gain 1 additional resource token of any type you choose.

conspire_cards.name: Tap into Oil Reserves
conspire_cards.text: Gain 1 Oil. Roll 1d6: on 5-6, gain 1 additional resource token of any type you choose.

conspire_cards.name: Proper Planning
conspire_cards.text: Gain 1 Industry. Roll 1d6: on 5-6, gain 1 additional resource token of any type you choose.

conspire_cards.text: Add 1d6 die to an attack combat roll of your choosing.

conspire_cards.name: Defender Instant Shield
conspire_cards.text: Add 1d6 to a defensive combat roll of your choosing.

conspire_cards.name: Old School RPG

conspire_cards.name: One Pulse Barrier
conspire_cards.text: Add +1 to a defense combat roll.

conspire_cards.name: Knowledge is Power
conspire_cards.text: If you control 2/3 of Intelligence-producing tiles, gain 2 BACs from spaceport deck.

conspire_cards.name: Civilian Goods Transport
conspire_cards.text: If you control 2/3 of Local Favor-producing tiles, gain any 4 resource tokens.

conspire_cards.name: Black Gold Syndicate
conspire_cards.text: If you control 2/3 of Oil-producing tiles, gain 2 Conspire cards.

conspire_cards.name: At the Cover of Darkness
conspire_cards.text: If you control 2/3 of Electricity-producing tiles, choose a player and steal: (1) 2 random resource tokens, (2) 1 random Conspire card, or (3) 1 random BAC from their hand.

conspire_cards.name: Factory Cost Savings
conspire_cards.text: If you control 2/3 of Industry-producing tiles, play a BAC without paying cost for 2 soldiers. May pay cost for the rest.

components_summary.soldier_miniatures: 112 player (4 colors x 28) + 24 separatist greys. Each player mini has 5 magnetized attachment points (Head, Chest, Legs, Backpack, Hands) and sits on a 40mm magnetized round base printed with a squad letter and soldier number (A1-A7, B1-B7, C1-C7, D1-D7) and bearing 3 blood-drop divots for damage tracking.
components_summary.equipment_modules: 160 total (20 types x 8 copies). Physical magnetized parts with unique sculpts and abbreviation engraved on underside. Destroyed modules return to the box for re-purchase.
components_summary.control_flags: 25 per player, 4 colors (100 total). Used for hex control and Equipment Display tracking. Flags on Equipment Display are permanent — never removed once placed, even if all soldiers carrying that module die. Marks unlocked BAC types for re-equipping
components_summary.damage_pegs: Pool of small red blood-drop pegs that snap into the divots on soldier bases. Each base holds up to 3 pegs (4th wound = death).
components_summary.combat_markers: 2 red circular markers, each the same size as the First Player marker. Used to identify board locations where declared combats are being resolved.
components_summary.combat_boards: 2 numbered staging boards (North and South), each with H.A.M.S positions 1-7 and corresponding die positions 1-7. Used to face opposing engaged soldiers and their assigned dice toward each other during combat.
components_summary.trackers: 1 shared round counter plus 1 color-coded tracker per player for Dominance Points and completed-turn status. Advancing the round resets every player tracker to ready.
components_summary.bunker_tokens: several — neutral fortifications: +1 all defense dice on hex, 1 per hex max, any unit benefits, destroyed by attacker winning combat
